_about: Pung's packaging revisions. A module's version is its author's; a revision here says Pung packed that same version again, and why. A device offers the same version with a higher revision as an update. scripts/build-catalog.py refuses a package whose contents changed with neither a new version nor a new revision. A module not listed is revision 1. When the module's own version moves on, its row may stay: revisions only count between packages of one version.
